annotations.description: Playing a second Momo when one is already on the battlefield is questionable. Momo is legendary, so casting a second copy will cause both to be put into the graveyard due to the legend rule (or the player keeps the new one and sacrifices the old one, but either way they don't get two Momos). The player loses the existing Momo that was already on board. However, the new Momo does trigger the old Momo's ability (+1/+1 until end of turn for another flying creature entering) before the legend rule applies, but then both die. This wastes a card for essentially no lasting board presence.

The second Momo is a dead card while the first is alive.
